newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Robeco buys Argyll Property Asset Managers.
newsitem.headline: Robeco buys Argyll Property Asset Managers.

text.p: Property investmend funds group Robeco Groep said on Monday it had reached agreement to buy Argyll Property Asset Managers Ltd from Scottish Amicable Investments Managers Ltd.
Glasgow-based Argyll manages property worth a total of 1.7 billion stg for its clients, Robeco said in a statement.
Argyll's largest client will remain Scottish Amicable with a property portfolio of 950 million stg, the Dutch group added.
Robeco said Argyll will remain operating independently in the U.K. and will aim to expand its position as a real estate management group.
It will also offer its services to investors outside of the U.K. who want others to manage their British property interests.

No financial detail of the purchase of Argyll were disclosed. Earlier this month, mutual life insurance company Scottish Amicable said it intended to sell its property management business to Robeco for an undisclosed sum.
